section_entries.mathematical_role: Translates Weil positivity into constrained convolution form, states the semi-local conjecture, explains Poisson normalization and Sonine witnesses, and compares time/energy and analytic/geometric viewpoints.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Poisson distributions and the scaling Hamiltonian generate Sonine elements
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: A differential operator enforcing simultaneous value and Fourier-value constraints transforms the Poisson comb into distributions supported away from zero; smoothing gives Schwartz Sonine functions, and a Fourier-symmetric polynomial in the scaling generator supplies a canonical choice.

neighboring_unit_entries.title: Analytic support exploitation versus global geometric structure
neighboring_unit_entries.why_material: The closing comparison identifies a plausible analytic next step and its vulnerability to principal-value normalization errors, while explaining what the global geometric model adds: an interpretation of scaling as Frobenius on the Scaling Site.

related_synthesis_entries.claim: A Fourier-symmetric polynomial in the scaling generator constructs Sonine-type constrained functions, while the same scaling viewpoint reads zeros as times and acquires a Frobenius interpretation globally.
related_synthesis_entries.limit: The connections are conceptual bridges across analytic and geometric viewpoints, not an established transfer of positivity between them.
related_synthesis_entries.title: Scaling dynamics links analytic Sonine constraints and geometric Frobenius
